to send students abroad.
intro1BodyStyled:
Too many students pick study destinations like they pick socks in the dark.
**We're here to fix that.**
With clarity and maybe a dash of cosmic stardust.
intro2HeadingStyled:
We started it so they
land in the right [mint]galaxy.[/mint]
intro2BodyStyled: Because education isn't just a destination. **It's an orbit worth calculating.**
teamSubStyled: We're mentors, misfits, and former international students who've made the mistakes—**so you don't have to**. We keep things real. And ridiculously supportive.
timelineHeadingStyled: From Stardust to Students: [mint]The Hubble Bubble[/mint] Story

timeline.title: The Spark
timeline.description: Jevin has an 'aha' moment after seeing friends frustrated abroad. Lightbulb goes off. So does the first Google Doc.

timeline.title: Takeoff
timeline.description: Hubble Bubble is officially born. First few students mentored. Zero marketing. Just word-of-mouth and good vibes.

timeline.title: The First Broadcast
timeline.description: Weekly Instagram webinars begin — answering student questions with no sales pitch. Attendance grows fast.

timeline.title: YouHaveJZ is Born
timeline.description: The mentoring project turns into a platform. Honest advice, passion-first alignment, and zero shady commissions.

timeline.title: Hubble Goes Global
timeline.description: HubbleX launches — a full-stack platform for international students. One place for guidance, planning, and community across borders.

missionBodyStyled: To help students discover their dream—not just go abroad, but go in the [orange]right direction.[/orange] No fake promises, no fine print, just honest mentoring.
visionBodyStyled:
A future where every student gets real guidance, not a sales pitch.
One where [orange]purpose[/orange] leads the way, and [orange]passion[/orange] powers the journey.
ctaTitle: We might just be the crew you need.
ctaSubStyled: Whether you're still figuring things out or already have a course in mind, **we're here to guide the next move.**
